mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and boosting risk premium expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a 60-day rolling average during periods of FEDFUNDS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and corporate earnings forecasts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative compared to a 60-day rolling average during periods of UNRATE above 8.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in gross domestic product (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, both driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by >0.2% while GDPC1 rises by >1% in the same month
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in the expected direction simultaneously, or 60-day returns fail to follow (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the supply index (INDPRO) alongside a decline in the federal funds rate indicates strong production growth and accommodative policy, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by >2% while FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.1% in the same month
failure_condition: The proxies move in opposite directions or 20-day returns fail to follow (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in labor participation (PAYEMS) coupled with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting confidence and equity values, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises by >5,000 while UNRATE falls by >0.1 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in the expected direction simultaneously, or 5-day returns fail to follow (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening cycle, higher long-term interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of FEDFUNDS above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong simultaneous growth in both gross domestic product (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises by >1% and HOUST rises by >10% in the same month
failure_condition: The proxies do not both reach the specified thresholds simultaneously, or 60-day returns fail to follow (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High labor participation (PAYEMS) alongside falling supply (INDPRO) suggests a labor surplus, raising inflation expectations and triggering a correction in stock prices, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 700 while INDPRO falls below 95 in the same month
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in the expected direction simultaneously, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
